resources.string: Sends this device’s microphone to the PC, so you can talk in games and chat apps there. Mute it from the stream menu; needs PC support.
Microphone access was not allowed, so the microphone stays off. Allow it in Android settings to talk through the PC.
Microphone: not offered by the PC
Keeps the stream’s sound from the speakers out of the microphone. Leave it on Automatic, which turns it off with headphones; pick On if the PC still hears its own sound.
Filters fans and other steady background noise out of the microphone. Leave it on.
Evens out quiet and loud speech. Turn it on if others hear your voice swing between too quiet and too loud.
Makes the microphone quieter or louder before it is sent. Raise it if others hear you too quietly, lower it if too loudly.
A round button over the stream that mutes and unmutes the microphone with one tap; drag it to move it. Off, mute from the stream menu instead.
Not on this device: %1$s. The microphone is sent without this processing.
The microphone stopped working, so it is muted now. Unmute it to try again.
